relationship_description: Oscar Rodriguez and Rufus Rodriguez are brothers, both prominent politicians from Mindanao.
Oscar Rodriguez is the brother of Maximo Rodriguez Jr., both of whom have held congressional seats.
Maximo Rodriguez Jr. is married to Mary Grace Rodriguez, both involved in party-list representation.
Rodolfo Albano is the father of Rudy Albano III, both serving as mayors and representatives in Isabela.
Orlando Fua is the father of Orlando Fua Jr., both of whom have served as representatives of Siquijor.
Eduardo Joson is the father of Eduardo Nonato Joson, both of whom have served as board members and governors in Nueva Ecija.
